`member` now shows each member's loan period (21 days for every type, per DEC-001), and all 19 tests pass (`dotnet test`). It's committed as `a7443b5` with the report in `.work/report.json`.
Borrowing doesn't use the new per-type definition yet, because DEC-W-3 was rejected, so LEND-L13-R2 is only partly done. The report lists that and the still-proposed DEC-009 as open questions.
I also updated the L01 test to expect the new `member` output. That change is new decision DEC-W-8, which I implemented before it was checked; the gate still has to authorize it.
